description: Elections Commission - Kandana arachchi was Selected as the member of the Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local authority (Bandaragama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member who ceased to belong to their political party, which falls under electoral processes and related matters as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
